title: Alinear FRONTIER_THIN con trabajo realmente enrutable por /wc
mission: Repair frontier-pressure scope so FRONTIER_THIN and claimable-useful metrics are derived from the current allocator-routable work domain rather than being suppressed by historical/inactive opportunity queue roots. Preserve durable history for diagnostics, keep portfolio recovery and current opportunity-plan semantics intact, and make any broader repository-history metric explicitly separate from the routing metric.
definition_of_done: Define one explicit current-routable job domain shared with or provably equivalent to the /wc allocator's normalized projects/plans semantics.
FRONTIER_THIN uses only current allocator-routable claimable work; historical/inactive opportunity queue roots cannot suppress the signal.
If repository-wide historical opportunity candidates remain useful for analysis, expose them under a separate metric that cannot be mistaken for allocator-routable claimable work.
Add a regression fixture where many stale historical READY opportunity rows exist but current allocator-routable work is below target; FRONTIER_THIN must be true.
Add a parity/reconciliation test covering current portfolio ready/recovery plus current queue-ready opportunities without silently dropping valid work.
Exact-snapshot CI executes the repaired compiler and the regression on a recorded source SHA and persists PASS/fail-closed evidence.
Efficiency ratchet passes; no existing superseded-owner, job-scoped-heartbeat, dedupe or malformed-highest-generation guards regress.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
